fit.figure: Figure 1. Typical Pulsed Current Gain vs. Collector Current (25 °C); Figure 4. Base-Emitter On Voltage vs. Collector Current (25 °C); Figure 2. Collector-Emitter Saturation Voltage vs. Collector Current (β = 10, 25 °C); Figure 6. Capacitance vs. Reverse Bias Voltage (Cibo); Figure 6 (Cobo); Figure 9 (Current Gain and Phase Angle vs. Frequency): |hfe| reaches 0 dB at 590 MHz, IC = 10 mA, VCE = 40 V; the table gives 300 MHz minimum at 20 V
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 5 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps); VAF 105.1 V, from Figure 16 (Output Admittance): hoe 8.69 µS at 1 mA, VCE = 10 V, so VAF = IC/hoe − VCE. BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJE, VJE, MJE from Cibo and CJC, VJC, MJC from Cobo against reverse voltage. TF from fT 590 MHz at 10 mA (Figure 9 (Current Gain and Phase Angle vs. Frequency): |hfe| reaches 0 dB at 590 MHz, IC = 10 mA, VCE = 40 V; the table gives 300 MHz minimum at 20 V), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 0.4 % (hFE), 0.9 mV (VBE) and 2.5 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
